evals.description: Posting controls package keeps core gates, handoffs, and context links visible.
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-accounting-posting-controls to review a journal posting command for source evidence, approval, period lock, idempotency, and double-entry safeguards.

evals.description: Approval and period-gate scenario exposes blocked outputs and disabled reasons.
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-accounting-posting-controls to check approval, reviewer state, period posture, blocked outputs, and disabled reasons before posting.

evals.description: Idempotency and concurrency scenario covers source version, stale-version, and correlation identifiers.
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-accounting-posting-controls to review idempotency, stale source versions, correlation and causation ids, and version/concurrency guards.

evals.description: Correction scenario covers reversal/rebook, amendment, restatement, immutability, and audit trail.
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-accounting-posting-controls to review reversal/rebook, amendment, restatement, immutable posted journals, and audit trail controls.
